items.title: xerj-org/xerj
items.content:
XERJ is the new way for AI to search data. Its autoindex capability activates agents to know your data without the token waste of grep and sed. One command indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory, using 40x fewer tokens than grep. Elasticsearch compatible, so existing clients just work.

summaries.zh: XERJ 是一种新的 AI 数据搜索方式，通过自动索引功能，让智能体无需大量 token 即可了解数据，比 grep 和 sed 效率高 40 倍。它支持代码、文档、日志和 PDF 的索引，用于搜索、RAG、安全审计和智能体内存，兼容 Elasticsearch，现有客户端可直接使用。语言为 Rust，获得 4859 星和 296 分叉。
summaries.en: XERJ is an AI-powered data search tool that uses autoindexing to efficiently search code, docs, logs, and PDFs. It reduces token usage by 40x compared to traditional methods like grep and sed, enabling faster searches, RAG, security audits, and agent memory. XERJ is Elasticsearch-compatible, requiring no changes for existing clients. Developed in Rust, it has 4,859 stars and 296 forks.
